// A chain of straight segments in space. When Closed, an extra segment joins
// the last point back to the first.
type Polyline3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IConnected, IBounded3D, ILength, IPointSet3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}
